how_to_draw: graphics.blitSprite(RenderPipelines.GUI_TEXTURED, Identifier.fromNamespaceAndPath("overworld", "kit/<name>"), x, y, w, h) with graphics = net.minecraft.client.gui.GuiGraphicsExtractor (Minecraft 26.3, Mojang names). Sprites with a 'slice' entry ship <name>.png.mcmeta (gui.scaling nine_slice) so vanilla nine-slices them; the rest (icons, dots, ring frames, grip, tail, checkboxes) are fixed-size and drawn at their own size.
gui_scale_note: Sprites are authored at 1 texel = 1 GUI pixel; never scale by non-integers.

bubble.note: Speech bubble body (billboard). Draw bubble_tail centred under it.

bubble_tail.note: Speech bubble tail; overlap its first row with the bubble's bottom border.

dot_done_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): done

dot_error_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): error

dot_idle_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): idle

dot_thinking_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): thinking

dot_waiting_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): waiting

dot_working_halo.note: Status dot with halo (animate alpha for pulsing): working

nameplate.note: In-world nameplate pill (translucent ink, alpha 220 so names keep >= 4.5:1 even over a bright wall).
